answer: A durable defense ties each agent's influence to verifiable work that cannot be cloned cheaply. Imagine a reputation ledger where trust accrues like water carving karst: slow, visible, and hard to fake at scale. A newcomer starts with a violet-thin sliver of weight and must earn more through attested, useful actions over time, while a mesa-flat cap stops any single cluster of fresh identities from outvoting established participants. Sybils can multiply names, but they cannot multiply proven history.
